nom: Kopari Beauty Sunglaze Sheer Setting Mist Sunscreen SPF 50

avis.titre: I wanted to love this product
avis.texte: It does everything it says, sets makeup, leaves a radiant finish with a fine mist. Overall I enjoyed the performance and use however I just can't get over the scent. As a chronically ill girlie with frequent nausea the scent is an absolute NO for me. Its the only reason I wouldn't purchase this again and the only reason I'm knocking off a star.
Purchased for a beach trip. Fine at 1st. Later eyes start to burn as product seeps into skin. Had to wash face, hours later eyes still stinging. Disappointed, had high hopes.

I dont know if the spf works well. I read some reviews, and proceeded with caution. I sprayed my face over makeup, closed my eyes and held my breath for at least 15 seconds after i stopped the mist. As soon as i opened my eyes it was over! I could barely keep my eyes open. It burned so bad and i felt it in my nose too. Had to wash my face quick. I dont know how you're supposed to use this over make up. Im just glad it at home and not when i was out and about.

Spray nozzle randomly broke on me after the 4th use. Wish I could return it but i think its been slightly over 30 days. Truly disappointing, i was going to do a review on tiktok but it wont even spray anymore and the bottle is still full. Won't repurchase.

I like how dewy it is and I used it when I was outside all day at the BTS concert and didn't get sunburned so it works! I mostly use it at work in the evenings to protect my skin when I'm outside. But it makes my eyes water after a bit and I can't stand that. I also really do not like the scent of it so I won't be finishing my bottle nor would I repurchase it or recommend it.
Does not have fresh melon scent. I cannot get past the smell so I will not use it again. Which is unfortunate.

avis.titre: Loved the product but customer service is disappointing
avis.texte: I purchased the spray last summer and love how easy it is to use. I don't wear foundation, just highlighter and blush and I use this when I'm in the sun for extended periods so I can re apply sunscreen every few hours as recommended without disturbing the makeup I do use. I would have given it 5 stars except, after only using half of the product the spray stopped working. I have tried everything, I cannot even take the top off to pour it into a different atomizer. Ulta is unwilling to do anything for me because it has been more than 60 days so I made a full price purchase but only got half of the product because of an issue, I have no control over. I have been shopping at Ulta for years. I have spent thousands of dollars over those years and they have just lost me as a customer because I've been unwilling to replace an item that cost less than $40. I am not trying to scam anyone as you can see by the picture. It is not expired yet and you can see how much product still remains. Incredibly disappointed.
I have always hated using the typical face sunscreen and admit sometimes don't use it. Kopari's new sunscreen is a game changer and I'll use it everyday!
I want to like this product but I can't get past the smell. I am having a hard time spraying this on my face. I don't really feel like it sets my makeup.

I tried this once spraying over my face and then a second time covering my eyes before spraying and both times it ended up making my eyes sting. My eye was watering so much it took off my makeup. I guess I'll try to use this on body instead so as to not waste it but I won't buy again
I haven't tested this out in the sun yet but I do like it as a setting spray. It has a nice soft smell and I love being able to apply sunscreen on my face without using a cream.

First of all im an esti👋🏻 very big on the idea of this being a sunscreen setting spray. It was recommended to me by the Ulta girl WHILE I was alreayd standing in line with my Charlotte Tilsberry setting spray. (holy grail btw and great for all skin types) she told me it was basically the same thing…. the biggest read flag to me was how many oil based ingredients that were in the product, (i have acneic/oily skin) but I took her word for it because she claimed it was even better than my charlotte tilsberry. Its only been a week and ive been having level 3 acneic breakouts…. oily skin humans do not buy this product. it also hurt my eyes and stinks. Would not recommend

The concept is so great of spf in a setting spray, but this product has consistently hurt my eyes as I've made my way thru the bottle. I jist realized that has been what was irritating one of my eyes. Prob due to the glitter and not an allergy since only one eye is bloodshot but both burn like crazy after a couple hrs of wear.

I love this product. The smell doesn't bother me at all, and I'm pretty scent-sensitive. Not sure why others hate the scent, but anyway…the lovely sheen it leaves on my skin caused my aesthetician to ask me what it was and she bought some, too! I appreciate the ease of topping off my spf during the day. I don't recommend spray spf as your only spf but to add a second layer of protection anytime is wonderful. Have repurchased twice and will continue to do so.

avis.titre: Water resistant setting spray with SPF!?
avis.texte: This has become my go to setting spray. I even use it at night for that dewy glow?

A product that you're supposed to spray on your face should not cause extreme stinging and burning if it gets anywhere near your eyes if you sweat and it runs into your eyes even if you do a light mist on your face with your eyes closed be prepared for your eyes to feel like they're on fire.

You have to put on a healthy amount. I never get sun. I am vacationing very sunny. Works great. I rubbed a ton in my husband's back. The rose lasted 2 days. Still oily after the shower. It's like skin healing and sun screen. Love it Don't forget to mix well. Separates when sitting alone.
Absolute dream.. love the refreshing feeling on my face with bonus SPF. No greasy residue
Only used it literally once. And I cannot push the spray down. :( bottle is full and no way to even open it up. But I do love this spray sunscreen. Used it a few times. This is my 4th bottle now

avis.titre: Really wanted to like but the spray bottle broke right away
avis.texte: Got about 10 sprays before it just didn't work anymore. Really disappointing.

avis.titre: Used at a friends and was hooked, no breakouts!!
avis.texte: I used this at a friends house while on vacation, I could not get the scent out of my head, it's like a perfume with a slight sunscreen smell, but in a good way. I had to get it the next day after getting home lol. I wouldn't pay this much normally but the bogo 50% off deal made it worth my time. No breakouts or eye irritation either! Make sure it sprays good before you leave the store! I hate buying something, bringing it home and then it not spraying/dispensing correctly!!
Love the convenience of all the products! The spray allows for great coverage and I am able to keep it in my beach bag for quick access. The quality and subtle sheen is 5 stars!!

Bought this with low expectations but I have been so happy with this product it does exactly what it claims to do .. i highly recommend it and I am a 66 yr old girlie and this product gives my skin a perfect flawless finish and that's hard to do at my age Constance

I really wanted to like this product, but I found the odor quite off-putting. The other products I received have a pleasant fragrance, but not this. It has the very faint odor of a stink bug to me--no kidding. Perhaps a genetic thing (like cilantro's taste for some). I can't get betond it; as such, it's worthless and sadly in the trash it goes.

avis.titre: Perfect setting spray with incredible glow!
avis.texte: I've bought this many times as nothing else compares! I always receive compliments that my skin is glowing! I love have the reassurance that my skin is also protected.
Sets your makeup, offers sun protection and isnt slimey I really couldn't ask for more. The mist is so fine and the finish isn't too shiny, very natural. Just perfection!
Gives a beautiful glow throughout the day. Bonus that it has SPF 50. Will definitely purchase again when my bottle runs out.

An associate sprayed it on in the store and swore by it, so I bought it. I liked the initial radiance, but on the drive home, I couldn't get over the smell. It's too gourmand.... smells like bad caramel and pancake syrup. I'll be returning it.

avis.titre: Love the way it looks, hate the way it smells.
avis.texte: Makes my skin look glowy and fresh, however, the scent is strong. At first, it smells like a mixture of medicine and sunscreen- which is okay, not great. When it "dries down" though, the smell turns and it smells like wet dog. I will continue to use it sparingly though as it is beautiful to finish off your makeup with. If you hate strong smells, this might not be for you.
I really like how soft of a mist this is, the slight fragrance is very nice and added bonus it has spf

avis.titre: Easy to reapply and use but strong odor
avis.texte: I do enjoy the concept of this product and how easy it is to reapply and use daily. The smell is very off putting to me. It smells very chemical and lingers.
1st time opening it and the nozzle doesn't work. Can't even use it!

I was soooo excited about this product and for 18$ for 1 oz( I got the small sample bottle) that's a lot for such little product but I was hopeful and excited. Going on a cruise and this would be perfect! Flash forward to the cruise day two. I am traveling with my beach bag to my room after laying out and I feel wetness. I look down and my bag is wet. The bottle with the cheap cap/sprayer opened during my walk and spilled everywhere. I didn't have a drop left. Very upsetting 😭😭 while the product is good. The smell could be better and OBVY fix the cap please 🙏🏼

I was nervous when people said this smelled chemical but ends up that's just what sunscreen smells like (except zinc ones) and this doesn't overly perfume over it which I really appreciate. It is effective sunscreen, I've been using it over my makeup to bike to work and I show up still looking nice even with wind, sun, or cold. It really does its job and I appreciate a product that delivers. Another thing I really like about this is that I have sun damaged skin and even without makeup underneath this makes me look nicely tanned rather than sun damaged.

avis.titre: Obsessed! The Perfect SPF Mist for Mature Skin
avis.texte: I'm 61, and finding a sunscreen that actually works with mature skin—without feeling heavy or settling into fine lines—has been a challenge. Sunglaze Sheer Setting Mist SPF 50 has honestly been a game changer for me. What I love most is how lightweight it feels. It goes on as a fine mist and doesn't disturb my makeup at all—in fact, it actually helps set it. My skin looks fresh and slightly glowy, not greasy or sticky. That's rare for a sunscreen, especially one with high SPF. I also appreciate how easy it is to reapply throughout the day. No rubbing, no mess—just a quick spray and I'm protected again. It's become a staple in my daily routine, whether I'm wearing makeup or not. At this stage in life, sun protection is non-negotiable, and this product makes it effortless and enjoyable. I genuinely love it and will absolutely keep repurchasing.
Worst product ever. I'm dry and this thing made it so much worse. My skin is tight and gross. Didn't set my makeup. It smells so chemically. Might as well spray your face with paint thinner.

I hate having to apply lotion sunscreen throughout the day, so I was looking for a spray face sunscreen. This has a beautiful shimmer, it's easy to apply, it smells nice. The bottle itself is beautiful and the spray is so easy to use. I really like this stuff.

Bought during the 21 days of beauty so 1/2 off but this slightly burns for a moment or two after spraying on my face. I don't have acne so no open wounds. Also smells like straight alcohol. I won't be purchasing again and if you have dry skin....stay far away!

avis.titre: Painful for sensitive skin but beautiful
avis.texte: Honestly burned like acid and made me look like I had 2 black eyes. Smells awful too. Like an old sunscreen that's been sitting in a hot trunk for 5 years. But it is beautiful and shimmery. If it wasn't for it burning it's possibly worth tolerating the smell.

Misted my face as I do with all the other setting sprays Ive used. Totally ruined my day! My eyes were shut & I fan dried but the fumes still got to me and burned for HOURS! My eyes were swollen from tearing up and makeup was ruined. Not to mention I refused to take pictures! Beware!

avis.titre: Love it, but hate the smell
avis.texte: I love how easily i can reapply my SPF throughout my day out by the pool or the beach. But the smell is so strong, almost toxic like, it feels like im throwing chemicals on my face. But definitely feels great
Ruins my makeup every time ive used this because it burns SO bad and makes me cry!!!!!

Have had this product less than a month now and unfortunately the sprayer has stopped working. I bought the full size. The protection seems to be adequate if you apply enough. I usually spray it into my hands generously and then rub/pat it on because the smell is strong when I try and spray it directly onto my face. Its a no for me.
I returned it because it smells so bad. Your face will smell terrible all day
Kopari has made using sunscreen so much nicer to use. They go on quickly and easily and moisturize my skin.
Love this product over all just not a huge fan of the smell- almost a chemical type of smell!
Such a great way to apply SPF to my skin. And, what a glow ! Have already recommended to other friends!
Hard to use a face spray that burns your eyes. Also- it is SUPER SHINY.

unfortunately it burns very badly. even after removing it still burned like straight acid. I really loved the shimmer though! very pretty if you test it first to make sure it doesn't burn you. however, it smells like that old bottle of sunscreen that's been in your trunk for 5 years. very bad.

I love the glowy finish of this setting spray and while i wouldnt use this without actual sunscreen i appreciate that i can touch up my sunscreenn without ruining my makeup. This is expensive though i bought it on sale!
First time using a setting spray with sunscreen. Make sure to shake the product prior to use and close your eyes. Feels hydrating.

I'm not sure how it's going to hold up. This is only my third day using it. And I'm regretting it already because of the smell. I'm going to put makeup forever Easy-Bake on top of this and hopes that it won't slide my makeup off. I wish I could just start over because the smell is awful. Again, I was looking for nice SPF coverage and tried this but I don't know if I'll be able to use it because the smell is so bad and it doesn't go away all day. I might use it on my neck and chest area. It does give a nice glow.
It looks beautiful but i cannot get over this terrible smell!!

avis.titre: The one star reviews are accurate
avis.texte: I was so excited to try this. I was hoping this would be my summer setting spray. But upon my first spray, it immediately burned my face. I attribute this to the first ingredient being alcohol. I sprayed it on my hand to test a more neutral area and it didn't burn, but after leaving it on for 10 minutes, it never dried down. All that was left was oil. I can't imagine how bad this would smear make up or even just be uncomfortable to wear. In theory a good product but i was severly disappointed with the product itself, not to mention the fact it burns.

This is a pump spray but it gives off an overwhelming chemical small like you sprayed it out of an arosole can. Sprayed it in the restroom of our trailer when camping had to open the windows and wait outside for the RV to air out.

I got this during the 21 days of beauty and wish i would have purchased two. It's a fine mist, fast absorbing and definitely great for easily reapplying. I don't understand the complaints about the smell. Maybe a bad batch because mine has a light scent but not unpleasant. Even my friend with bromidrophobia was not bothered by the scent and asked to use it.

I always hated that most sunscreens seem to be for the morning before makeup application and then the rest of the day you are meant to mess up your makeup in order to reapply or you just go without. So this is the perfect solution for reapplication throughout the day. I also use it without any makeup and love the glow it gives my skin in the summertime. Its a perfect addition to regular spf use to make sure youre protected while also making your skin look healthy and glowy

I want to love this, but it irritates my eyes so much that I end up washing it off. The point of a setting spray is to set makeup and dry without disturbing the look, but I find this formula really greasy. Rather than a glow, I feel like you just end up looking oily and sweaty. I haven't been able to keep it on long enough to see how effective it is as a sunscreen. I hope this gets a reformulation or a new product comes out that addresses these issues.

avis.titre: love Kopari, but this was a miss
avis.texte: I have just about all their sun products and was excited to get this in one of their kits. idea is amazing, but it smells like pure alcohol no matter how much you shake it... this one is a pass

avis.titre: Great if you can get over the smell!!!
avis.texte: This product is absolutely great if you can get over the smell! I read reviews stating the smell was unpleasant and they were not exaggerating. I was blown away the first time i used this!!! However, i also was blown away at how glowy my makeup looked after. If you can get over the overwhelming smell then this is totally worth buying. Have neen using every single day for that glowy skin look and the extra SPF. Still giving it 5 stars because the results are perfect.
This is a pretty setting mist and its not chunky glitter its subtle but still give a pretty glow. BUT the smell is so bad! It smell like DEET and the cheapest spray on sunscreen you can find.

avis.titre: Burns like fire when it seeps into eyes
avis.texte: Unfortunately, this product is not face/eye friendly. Even avoiding the eye area, if you spray on your face some of it will eventually migrate to your eyes. It then burns for hours.

I bought this for a pretty sparkly sunblock spray, but I've used multiple times and no dewy, sparkly skin as advertised. Goes on with a watery consistency. Not what I thought I was getting . It looks pretty in the bottle but that is about it. Doesnt work well especially for the price.

I really wanted to like this, and the product may have worked as intended, but it smelled so strong in the end I just couldn't stand it. The first one I bought was like pure alcohol and paint thinner. I returned it for another that wasnt quite as bad, but still smelled like paint and way too strong. It took over an hour for the smell to fade, and I'd already have a headache.
This works but it smelled really bad and when in the water it burned my eyes so bad

avis.titre: Beautiful glow but burns my eyes and makes my contacts foggy
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this. The idea of something that I can reapply above my makeup is so appealing. Unfortunately it burns my eyes terribly and causes my contact lens to get foggy. Like an oil is on them. I have tried spraying it on my fingers and then patting it on to my face, but it still seems to eventually run into my eyes as the day goes on, especially if I'm outside doing something active. I have switched over to the Sun Veil Illuminating Elixir and I love that 1000% more. No issues with the eyes and it also creates a beautiful glow. Harder to reapply over foundation, but many days I just use that and no other makeup, given the glow. I'm using the remaining sun glaze setting mist on my neck and check, just to not waste the product, but I won't repurchase this one.

avis.titre: Do not ruin your makeup with this!
avis.texte: Terrible product. I was excited to try it and the one positive ill give is the sprayer is a pleasant mist. This is very very oily and will not "set" your makeup at all. In fact it will do the opposite and melt it off. Especially mascara. It also expires way faster than it says. I have a travel size one that doesnt expire till next year and it smells like bad oil already. It also burns your eyes terribly so if you put it on your forehead and it drips into your eyes you will be in pain. Would never repurchase this.
Wanted to love this setting spray for a glowy dewey look, which it does offer. However the smell is that of a rancid lake on an extremely hot day.

"I love the finish of this SPF setting spray — it leaves my skin looking glowy and smooth without feeling heavy or greasy. It's great for refreshing sunscreen throughout the day. Unfortunately it burns my eyes really badly if it gets anywhere near them, so I can't spray on my face or anywhere near my eyes. Beautiful finish, but the eye irritation is definitely something to be aware of."

I bought this for face SPF reapplication. I didn't experience any burning eyes like others. But, it is fragranced as most Kopari products are. it has a strong Limón Verde fragrance. I have been breaking out and perhaps this is the culprit. I prefer to use fragrance free products for the face. I use it now on my hair and it works great as a hair SPF. I wouldn't recommend for the face. keep perfume away from your face especially if you have sensitiveskin.
This caused me to have severely itchy and watery eyes for several hours after use. Disapponting because I love the concept.

I wanted to love it so bad, it looks so pretty and its safe to use for your face throughout the day, sounds easy to use you just spray and the small one fits in your purse BUT THE SMELL!! OMG its SOOOO bad, smells like wet dog. Very unpleasant.

avis.titre: Not sure if it works because it STINKS
avis.texte: I wish I could return it but I lost the receipt and used it a couple of times hoping I'd get used to the smell. But no. It doesn't seem to be out of date or anything, but it has this awful smell that I can't really identify. Even once it dries down I can still smell it. Not sure if I just got a funky bottle or what.
This product is fenomenal it has sun protection and it give a perfect glow. Absolutely loving this product🩷🩷🩷

I really enjoy this product, it gives me that glow from within. Ethereal looking skin! It was easy to use until the spray nozzle stopped pumping out the product. I would give this product a 5 star rating but the pump being a dud made it a 3 star product.
The ease of a Spray with some bonus glow! I just love it! I am on my 2nd bottle. Plan on buying a 3rd!
I use this for reapplication during the day for my face. I can quickly spray and go. I also appreciate that it is spf 50.

I thought I was going to like this product since I like to look dewy and glowy, and I love skin protection products. BUT, this spray, has the most unappealing smell and it lingers. If you have dogs and when they get wet, thats what this smells like. Does a good job making my make look glowy, but I returned this after a few uses.

I think its a beautiful finish but I cannot get past the smell, it smells so disgusting and it kind of lingers for a while. If you're okay tolerating it then this is for you. I couldnt do it unfortunately.
Love it. Use it everyday every couple hours for sunscreen over makeup!

avis.titre: Leaves skin beautiful and glowy but smells awful
avis.texte: I love the way this looks on my skin after I do my makeup it's glowy and gorgeous! And has good spf ! But the smell is like paint it stinks.
What I like about this mist is It's very light and dries quickly. You have a very nice sheer glimmer.

The best setting spray! Great spf protection! I don't like the feel of sunscreen on my face. This works very well. Spray on my face before pool side, going to fairs, or outdoor college football games! No sun burn or even redness on my face. I don't wear foundation or any other sun protection. Skin doesn't feel stick afterwards. Smells great. Gives a great glow to the face too!! I recommend to people all the time!!!!

The first 4 ingredients in this product are very toxic. I put it through my Yuka app and it got a rating of poor. It has a ver chemical smell and it stings. It fors have some clean ingredients but it has some very bad ingredients. Its a return gor me.
I wanted to love this but it smells so stro nyly of burning rubber. I sprayed it on and immediately took it off because I couldnt stand the smell and I could still smell it aftr washing my face!

avis.titre: Wanted to love it but didn't
avis.texte: There were raving reviews about this product and I really wanted to love it, but when I used it, it made me super oily and it smelled very strongly of chemicals. I did not like it at all.

avis.titre: Lightweight and great for so many tasks
avis.texte: I use this to apply concealer with and it blends beautifully with no dragging. I love the sun protection built in.
Beautiful finish, spf benefit, large amount for the purchase price - win all around for me.

This is by far the absolute best setting spray/sunscrean I've tried, and I have tried many! The spray comes out in a smooth fine mist, no splatters or wet areas, dries quickly and leaves the prettiest dewy look on my skin. Not sparkley or flashy, just naturally glowing. My makeup wears all day long and it does not irritate my super sensitive skin. I'm ordering my second bottle now and a travel size for my purse. A must try!!!
The best setting spray I have ever used. I'm on my 3rd bottle and receive compliments all the time of how well my skin looks. I'm 51
Not rly worth the hype, way too exspensive. It looks, smells and acts the same as a drug store spray spf.
A beautiful way to add extra sun protection and a light glow!
This is my all time favorite setting spray. It gives a beautiful glowing finish to any makeup look.

This is an amazing product. It is easy to apply, has good coverage and makes my skin look glossy and smooth. It gives good sun protection but does need to be reapplied. I highly recommend it. I have sensitive skin and this did not irritate my skin at all.
Its great glow and minimal sparklin. BUT IT BURND YOUR EYES THROUGH OUT THE DAY.

This Sunglaze Sheer Setting Mist Sunscreen from Kopari is so light and adds moisture and hydration to my skin without feeling heavy. I love that It's 50 spf and it dries pretty fast. It's also perfect for on the go. Gifted by Kopari Beauty.
I like the product itself for the glow it creates, but it has a weird chemical smell
I really wanted to love this but, my eyes were burning and tearing and as much as I love a dewy look, this is way too oily to spray "liberally" a top of makeup. Great packaging but, that's about it.

This is the most beautiful setting spray PLUS the hydration without the greasy feeling. I highly recommend. It applies so effortlessly on-top of makeup or even just a natural look to add sparkle and protection from the sun. I am obsessed!!! Gifted by koparibeauty

This is sooo pretty!! Make sure to shake it before you use it to get all the glow sitting at the bottom! I have used their oils before and I love them too! The only problem with them is they leave a trace where ever you touch so this Doesn't! Gifted by koparibeauty.

I been using this spf 50 on the daily with and without makeup. I have found out it works better before make up application. Is lightweight and it Doesn't feel greasy on the skin. I love that have hyaluronic acid , vitamin E and Vitamin C. Gifted by koparibeauty

Obsessed with the glass skin finish this mist gives!! It melts right over makeup with zero grease and leaves my skin looking fresh. Love that It's SPF 50 and the lightweight spray makes reapplying actually enjoyable. Perfect for daily use over skincare or makeup. Gifted by Kopari.

I am so excited to try this Sunglaze Sheer Setting Mist Sunscreen SPF 50 from Kopari beauty. It gives me a coveted glass-skin finish‚Äîdewy, hydrated, and protected from harmful UVA/UVB rays. It is lightweight, non-greasy and quickly drying ultra-fine mist that perfectly sets makeup, refreshes the skin, and delivers a boost of moisture thanks to hyaluronic acid and polyglutamic acids. Complimentary from koparibeauty

This setting mist makes daily SPF feel effortless. With its sheer, lightweight formula, it sets makeup beautifully while adding an invisible layer of sun protection. The mist goes on evenly‚Äîno white cast, no greasiness‚Äîand leaves skin with a soft, natural glow. It's perfect for mid-day touch-ups or reapplication on the go. Compared to other SPF sprays, this one feels more hydrating and gives a refreshed finish rather than a heavy film. A must-have for glowing, protected skin all day long. Gifted by Koparibeauty.

I love this sunscreen mist! It's the first one I've tried that leaves a dewy glow. I especially like using it on my collarbone to add definition, but it also looks great over makeup, giving a healthy, radiant finish. Gifted by kopari

I really like this product and the fact that it has shimmer inside so when I use it for sunscreen, it also gives me some glimmer effect on my skin. This is great to use if you have a pool party or an outdoor event where you want your skin to shine, but also want to be protected by the sun. Gifted by kopari

I love the Kopari Sunglaze Sheer Setting Mist Sunscreen SPF 50! It's super lightweight, dries quickly, and layers perfectly over makeup without messing it up. My skin feels hydrated and has that glowy, glass-skin finish all day. The melon scent is refreshing but not overpowering, and it makes reapplying sunscreen so easy. It's the perfect mist for daily sun protection and a radiant glow! I received this Complimentary from koparibeauty

Absolutely love this setting mist! It gives my skin the most beautiful, natural glow without feeling oily or heavy. I use it after makeup or whenever I need a quick refresh, and it instantly makes my skin look radiant and hydrated. It's lightweight, sets everything perfectly, and the fact that it has SPF 50 is a total win. A new must have in my routine! Gifted by Kopari Beauty
